Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1320
Claimant:
Victor Gibson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
August 24, 2024
First notice of loss received from the policyholder's driver describing a side impact at a signalized intersection. The
claimant reports a concussion and is now represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's
office.
October 16, 2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Requested the scene
photographs and the statements of the two independent witnesses.
November 20, 2024
Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same sequence of events as the policyholder. Both vehicles had the
right-of-way questions addressed by the signal phase noted in the report.
November 28, 2024
Photos from the vehicle inspection show damage to the driver's side door and quarter panel consistent with the
reported angle of impact. The estimate will be reviewed against the photographs.
December 16, 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the loss date. No issues with the policy
terms were found.
December 25, 2024
Reviewed the vehicle's prior repair history and found no earlier damage to the same panels. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
January 3, 2025
Counsel's letter arrived requesting medical authorizations. Forwarded the request to the claims file and noted the
claimant's account has been consistent across every contact so far.
January 4, 2025
Received the initial medical records showing a concussion diagnosis. Records do not indicate any prior injury to the
head or neck area.
January 8, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury. Requested updaetd records and a
treating physician summary to understand the course of care.
January 11, 2025
Reviewed the medical file with the claims supervisor. Whether the concussion was caused by this collision has not
yet been determined, and the file remains open pending further medical review.
January 26, 2025
Sopke with counsel's office to confirm receipt of the requested records and to advise that the medical causation
review is ongoing.
February 1, 2025
Scheduled a follow-up with the claims supervisor to review the outstanding medical records and set the next action
date for the bodily injury evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
